notes:
fix(release): drop upload-artifact — hit a persistent quota wall

Deviates from the plan's stated criterion ("installer/output/ uploaded as
a workflow artifact regardless of publish success", 2026-08-17-auto-update.md
Task 9) after v0.3.0's release run repeatedly failed here:
"Artifact storage quota has been hit... Usage is recalculated every 6-12
hours." Deleting the 18 old pre-existing HiTopInvoicing-windows-* artifacts
(~4.6GB, from desktop-build.yml, unrelated to this work) freed the actual
storage but the quota COUNTER itself doesn't recalculate on delete — it
sat "hit" across three retries over several hours regardless.

This step was never load-bearing for the actual publish: the following
`gh release create` step uploads the installer straight to the ht-dist
GitHub Release via the Releases API, a completely separate mechanism from
Actions artifact storage that shares none of this quota. Removing it
avoids reproducing this exact block on every future release; the
downloadable-artifact convenience is lost, but the release itself is not
weaker for it.
